note: Rustic wooded campground a quarter mile east of the St. Croix River off Highway 70, with trails to river overlooks. The Trade River equestrian campground and the Sioux Portage group camp are separate. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page, forest page and the campgrounds brochure/map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 30 sites (101-130), electric at seven, vault toilets, seasonal water, dump; open May 1-Oct 31; reservations required. Pin is the Highway 70 entrance, about 900 m north of the loops; re-pin proposed. Not waterfront confirmed. Fees and site lengths unconfirmed.
flags: PIN: 45.7731,-92.7763 -> 45.7650,-92.7780 (imagery estimate, about 900 m). The stored point is the campground road's junction with Highway 70 (the DNR 'Get Directions' point 45.7733,-92.7763). The road runs south to the registration area (OSM node 45.76598,-92.77682) and the site loops lie south and west of it on Esri imagery, centred about 45.7650,-92.7780.
SEASON: added 05-01..10-31 from the DNR brochure ('Camping is available May 1 through Oct. 31 at the St. Croix Campground').
HOOKUPS: seven public electric sites on the brochure map; amperage on no page I could read, so hookups were not written.

UNCONFIRMED: stored $19-34 (GoingToCamp fee panel 2026-10-10) and per-site lengths are on wisconsin.goingtocamp.com (refuses, not retried). The old note's 'Large well-spaced sites take a 23-ft rig' has no source I could read; dropped. The brochure asks that camping units stay on gravel pads.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The St. Croix is about 250 m+ west of the westernmost loop through forest ('0.25 miles east of the ... St. Croix River').
STATUS: the DNR notice that the forest's water systems are shut down for the season is the ordinary end of season; not a closure.

PHONE: 715-463-2898 confirmed on the forest page. WEBSITE: https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/StateForests/govknowles live; camping page https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/StateForests/govknowles/recreation/camping optional replacement.
